doc.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Joking about the eight-hour interview
summary: After eight hours of interviewing Mandel jokes with Kirchner about hoping the tape is burned.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: Alright it's really been a fucking drag these last eight hours, I don't know why we did this…
And I hope you'll burn it.
As a friend of mine once said, “Don’t say fuck in front of the K.I.D.S.”
It wasn’t too long that I saw a woman when I was in New York, on a snowy day, step into the gutter and yell, “Oh shit, I just stepped in dog poo poo!”
